summary: Saia, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 3, 2026, announcing via press release its July and August 2026 less-than-truckload (LTL) operating data. The release reports year-over-year increases in shipments per workday (0.8% July, 1.1% August), tonnage per workday (7.8% July, 8.7% August), and weight per shipment (7.0% July, 7.5% August). The registrant is a trucking company, and the filing is a routine operational update. No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, management change, or capital action—is involved. The 8-K items (8.01 Other Events and 9.01 Exhibits) confirm routine disclosure. The forward-looking cautionary language is standard. What to watch: operational metrics may influence earnings estimates but do not trigger special-situation analysis.
